research_interests: Traffic world models beyond ego-vehicle control: learning multi-agent dynamics from drone trajectories, evaluating their decision utility, and supporting site-level safety assessment and digital-twin validation.

items.label: Traffic world models and digital twins
items.text: Develop graph-conditioned latent dynamics with neural ODE decoding from inD, rounD, and highD trajectories; assess behavioral validity and cross-site transfer of learned models and calibrated simulators.

items.label: Closed-loop diagnostics
items.text: Design paired action/graph source-switch tests and temporal controls to isolate distribution shift and early error compounding.

items.label: Missing-history evaluation
items.text: Distinguish input-level missingness from latent-pathway interventions; compare forecasters under matched information conditions.

items.label: Decision utility and safety assessment
items.text: Test whether prediction gains improve action ranking and forecast-based safety screening; develop recording-disjoint, leakage-controlled protocols with fixed candidate banks, conflict indicators, and tail-risk diagnostics.

items.label: ProSafeAV
items.text: Integrate world-model reinforcement learning, traffic-conflict indicators, and extreme value theory; evaluate policies in CARLA-based simulation.

graduate_research: Conducted transportation research with Prof. Zhiyuan Liu; contributed to collaborative work on reinforcement learning for joint travel-mode and departure-time choice.

skills.label: Modeling
skills.text: Graph neural networks; recurrent state-space models; neural ODEs; reinforcement learning.

skills.label: Safety and evaluation
skills.text: Surrogate safety measures; extreme value theory; bootstrap diagnostics; recording-disjoint evaluation.

skills.label: Software
skills.text: Python; PyTorch / PyTorch Lightning; CARLA; Git; LaTeX.
